name: Lórév (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and green, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Lórév: a crowned blue and green shield with a white horse, between branches.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lórév arms with crown and branches
